title: Introduction to Operating Systems
instructor: Peter Chen, Manos Kapritsos, Baris Kasikci
workloadNotes: Four projects (Project 1 individual at 3%, Projects 2-4 in groups of 2-3 at 15% each), plus midterm and final exam (26% each). Must average a passing grade on exams to pass the course. 3 late days per group for the semester. Optional advanced supplemental course EECS 498-002 runs alongside for concurrently enrolled students.
prerequisitesText: EECS 281 and EECS 370; expected to understand data structures and computer architecture, have extensive C/C++ experience, and be familiar with UNIX.
textbooks: Thomas Anderson and Michael Dahlin, Operating Systems: Principles and Practice, 2nd ed. (recommended)
